d: If you are eager to do something, you want to do it very much and are excited about it.
An eagle is a large, powerful bird of prey with a curved beak and strong claws.
Your ears are the two parts of your body on the sides of your head that you use for hearing.
If something is early, it happens before the usual or expected time.
If you earn money, you receive it as payment for the work that you do.
The earth is the planet we live on, or the soil in which plants grow.
An earthquake is a sudden, violent shaking of the ground causing great destruction.
If you do something with ease, you do it very easily without any trouble or difficulty.
The east is the direction where the sun rises in the morning.
If something is easy, it is not difficult to do or understand.
When you eat, you put food into your mouth, chew it, and swallow it.
The economy is the system of how money and goods are produced and used in a country.
Economic means relating to trade, industry, and the management of money.
The edge of something is the place or line where it ends or its outer boundary.
If you edit a text or video, you correct and change it to make it ready to be published.
An edition is a particular version of a book or magazine printed at one specific time.
An editor is a person whose job is to check, correct, and organize articles before they are printed.
If you educate someone, you teach them over a period of time, usually at a school or university.
Education is the process of learning and teaching in schools, colleges, or universities.
An effect is a change, reaction, or result that is caused by an event or action.
If something is effective, it works well and produces the exact result you want.
If you work efficiently, you do it quickly and effectively without wasting any time or energy.
An effort is the physical or mental energy that you need to do something.
An egg is an oval object laid by a female bird that can be eaten as food.
Eight is the number between seven and nine.
You use either to introduce the first of two options or possibilities.
Your elbow is the joint in the middle of your arm where it bends.
The elder of two people is the one who was born first and is older.
If people elect someone, they choose that person to hold a public office by voting for them.
An election is a formal and organized process where people vote to choose a political leader.
Electric tools and machines are powered by electricity.
Electricity is a form of energy used for lighting, heating, and running machines.
Electronic devices have small parts like microchips that control the flow of electricity.
If someone or something is elegant, they are pleasing, graceful, and stylish in appearance.
An element is one important part or feature of a whole system or plan.
An elephant is a very large grey animal with a long trunk and big ears.
An elevator is a machine in a building that moves people up and down between the floors.
Eleven is the number that comes after ten and before twelve.
You use else to talk about a different person, thing, or place in addition to the one mentioned.
An email is a digital message sent from one computer or phone to another over the internet.
If you embarrass someone, you make them feel ashamed, shy, or uncomfortable.
If you are embarrassed, you feel ashamed, self-conscious, or socially uncomfortable.
If someone emerges from a place, they come out of it and become visible.
An emergency is a serious, unexpected, and dangerous situation that needs immediate action.
An emotion is a strong feeling such as love, anger, joy, or fear.
If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly.
Emphasis is special importance, value, or attention given to something.
If you emphasize a point, you show that it is particularly important.
An empire is a large group of countries ruled by a single powerful government or emperor.
If a company employs you, they hire you and pay you to work for them.
An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or another person.
An employer is a person, company, or organization that hires workers and pays them a salary.
If a container or space is empty, it has absolutely nothing or no one inside it.
If you enable someone to do something, you give them the ability, tools, or opportunity to do it.
If you encounter a problem or a person, you experience or meet them unexpectedly.
If you encourage someone, you give them confidence and support to do something.
The end of something is the final part of it when it finishes or stops.
An enemy is a person who hates you and actively tries to harm you.
Energy is the physical and mental strength you have to do active things without getting tired.
If you engage in an activity, you participate in it or become deeply involved in it.
An engine is the machine with moving parts that makes a vehicle move.
An engineer is a professional who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or structures.
If you enhance something, you improve its quality, value, or appearance.
If you enjoy something, you find pleasure, satisfaction, and happiness in doing it.
If something is enormous, it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.
If you have enough of something, you have as much as you need or want.
If you ensure that something happens, you make certain that it happens successfully.
When you enter a room or a building, you go inside it.
An enterprise is a large and complicated project, or a business company.
If you entertain people, you amuse them or keep them interested, usually with a performance.
Entertainment consists of performances, movies, or activities that give people pleasure.
Enthusiasm is a strong feeling of excitement and eager interest in something.
If you are enthusiastic, you show a lot of excitement and positive interest about things.
The entire thing means the whole thing, with absolutely no parts left out.
If something is entirely true, it is completely and absolutely true without exception.
An entrance is a door, gate, or opening that you use to go inside a building.
An entry is the physical act of coming or going into a place.
The environment is the natural world of land, sea, and air that we live in.
An episode is one single part of a television or radio story that is broadcast in a series.
If two things are equal, they are exactly the same in size, number, or value.
If people are treated equally, they are treated in exactly the same fair way.
Equipment is the specific set of tools, clothing, or machines you need for a job or activity.
An era is a long period of history that is known for a particular characteristic or event.
An error is a mistake, especially one that causes a problem or affects the final result.
If you escape from a dangerous place, you succeed in getting away from it.
You use especially to emphasize that something is more important than other things.
An essay is a short piece of writing on one particular subject, often written by a student.
If something is essential, it is absolutely necessary and extremely important.
If you establish an organization or business, you start it and make it permanent.
An estate is a very large area of land in the country, usually owned by one wealthy family.
An event is something important, unusual, or planned that happens.
If something happens eventually, it happens at the end of a long process or period of time.
If a number or measurement is exact, it is completely correct in every detail.
You use exactly to emphasize that a statement or measurement is completely accurate.
If you exaggerate, you talk about something to make it seem larger, better, or worse than it really is.
An exam is a formal, written test of your knowledge or ability in a particular subject.
An excuse is a reason you give to explain why you did something wrong or failed to do a task.
If you excuse someone, you forgive them for a small fault, mistake, or bad behavior.
An estimate is a rough guess or calculation of how much something will cost or how big it is.
If you estimate a quantity, you try to logically judge its value or size without exactly measuring it.
